variants.name: Veal with Vegetables 400 g
variants.about_this_item: Monge Fresh Puppy is a complete and balanced puppy food. The fresh veal meat content guarantees the high biological value of the recipe. Vegetables are an ideal source of carbohydrates to provide daily energy, as well as natural vitamins and minerals.
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Meats and derivatives (fresh meat; calf 20% and liver 16%), vegetables (carrots, peas and potatoes 6%), cereals, oils and fats, mineral substances.

Analytical constituents: Crude Protein: 7.0%, Crude fibre: 0.5%, Crude fats: 6.0%, Crude ash: 3.0%, Moisture: 79%

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES: Vitamin D3 450 IU/kg, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopherol-acetate) 15 mg/kg, Selenium (Sodium selenite 0.04 mg/kg) 0.018 mg/kg, Manganese (Manganous sulphate monohydrate 9 mg/kg) 2.9 mg/kg, Zinc (Zinc oxide 32 mg/kg): 25.7 mg/kg, Copper (Copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 3.5 mg/kg) 0.89 mg/kg, Iron (Iron (II) sulphate monohydrate 15 mg/kg) 4.93 mg/ kg, Iodine (Calcium iodate anhydrous 1.8 mg/kg) 1.17 mg/kg.
